title: You Don't Deserve A Vacation Until You're Ripped
hook: You deserve a break once you're ripped.
body:
When you go on vacation, the usual rules of working out and eating for most people go out the window.

So before you establish good health habits, vacation is toxic to your fitness goals.
close: You can enjoy those vacations eventually, but it's going to be way more enjoyable when you're ripped and when you have your health habits dialed in.
